0.3.0-Continued.description:
## Why Wikipelago Continued?

The original Wikipelago project was abandoned. With the original author's permission, this fork continues public development and hosting (MIT), with credit to [Skrumptily69](https://github.com/Skrumptily69/Wikipelago).

Live web client: https://wikipelago-contd.onrender.com/

## What's new in 0.3.0 (vs 0.2.0)

- Larger curated article pool, with category tags and a new music category
- Updated seed defaults
- Optional display-lens difficulty unlocks (and related sanities)
- Client and bridge reliability improvements, cleanup, and bugfixes
- Docs and packaging polish for Archipelago 0.6.7

## Install

Download `Wikipelago.apworld` and the YAML template from this release, install the apworld, generate/host as usual, then connect with the web client above.

Docs: [Overview](https://github.com/Eske-N/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/overview.md) · [Setup](https://github.com/Eske-N/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md) · [Options](https://github.com/Eske-N/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/options.md)

release-2.description:
## Wikipelago v0.1.1

Beta update for Wikipelago.

### Changes
- Expanded article pools across all supported categories
- Added many more titles, so category-restricted seeds are less likely to fail
- Tightened category filtering so disabled categories do not leak into seeds
- Removed the web client search bar to prevent direct target skipping
- Updated web client cache versioning for cleaner deploys
- Improved reconnect behavior so the web client can preserve progress after disconnects (recovery may still not be fully reliable)

### Included Categories
- Video Games
- Board Games
- Movies
- TV Shows
- Anime/Manga
- Sports
- Science/Space
- Technology/Internet
- History
- Geography/Landmarks
- Food/Cuisine
- Art/Literature
- Mythology/Folklore

### Notes
- Recommended Archipelago version: `0.6.6`
- Reconnect progress restoration is still not fully reliable in all cases
- If using a narrow category setup with very high round counts, generation may still require enabling more categories or lowering `check_count`

### Files
This release should be used with:
- `Wikipelago.apworld`
- updated Wikipelago YAML template
- latest deployed web client

### Thanks
Thanks to everyone for testing and sending feedback. The reports directly helped improve seed quality and category behavior.

releases.description:
## Wikipelago v0.1.0 (Public Beta)

First public release of Wikipelago for Archipelago.

### Included
- Custom `Wikipelago.apworld` for Archipelago 0.6.6
- Web client + bridge deployment support
- Reconnect/session progress restoration support
- Expanded article system with category toggles in YAML
- No-repeat round generation logic
- Goal completion + fragment-based progression flow
- Updated YAML template and setup docs

### Notes
- Recommended Archipelago version: 0.6.6
- If hosting on free Render, cold starts may occur after inactivity.
- Players should use the included YAML template and the same APWorld version used for generation.

### Known Limitations
- Hosting uptime depends on your deployment provider/tier.
- Category/topic classification is keyword-based and may still classify edge-case pages imperfectly.

v0.2.0.description:
## Wikipelago v0.2.0


### Major Changes
- Grand Goal logic now correctly requires only the configured Knowledge Fragment count
- Improved default settings to reduce early BK risk in asyncs and community games
- Added clearer YAML guidance for safer setting combinations
- Added Searchsanity and Scrollsanity support (optional, disabled by default)
- Improved reconnect/resume behavior in the web client
- Expanded validation and fuzz testing tools for safer updates

### Recommended Defaults
The included YAML template now uses a safer baseline for play:
- `check_count: 25`
- `required_fragments: 5`
- `start_rounds_unlocked: 10`
- `rounds_per_unlock: 5`
- `random_goal_article: true`

### Notes
- Recommended Archipelago version: `0.6.6`
- Searchsanity and Scrollsanity are currently optional and off by default
- Reconnect behavior is improved, but continued real-world testing is still encouraged

### Included
- Updated `Wikipelago.apworld`
- Updated YAML template
- Updated web client / bridge source
- Netlify config for frontend hosting with backend proxying

### Thanks
Thanks to everyone who tested seeds, reported broken targets, and gave sync pacing feedback. Those reports directly shaped this update.

v0.5.0-Bingo!.description:
## Wikipelago 0.5.0-Bingo!

Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7** (or compatible).  
Web client: https://wikipelago-contd.onrender.com/

**Hosts:** install this `Wikipelago.apworld`, restart the Launcher, and **generate a new seed** for 0.5 features.  
**Players:** browser + web client only (no apworld needed to play).

In-progress **0.4.x** rooms can usually keep playing on the new client; Back behavior may feel different. New bingo / progressive toolkit need this apworld.

---

### New in 0.5.0

#### Letter-pair bingo
- Optional **letter-pair bingo** boards (on by default). **Multi-board** via `bingo_cards_start` + **Progressive Bingo Card**
- Stamp pairs from visitng pages; row / column / diagonal / full-card checks. Each line is a location to check

#### Progressive toolkit
- **Progressive Back** (replaces one-shot Back Button) — per-round back button maximum uses increases with this unlock
- **Progressive Reroll** — per-round target rerolls unlocks progressively

#### Misc bug fixes, gameplay balance, documentation
- Grand Goal is **distinct** from the final round target (already in 0.4.2)
- Connection panel and disconnect control
- Resume/reconnect hardening
- Target page tooltip when hovering
- FAQ page created (`docs/faq.md`)
- Random first-round opening page fix
- Dark-UI table color fix
- Portal/namespace error toasts

---

### Install
1. Download `Wikipelago.apworld` (+ optional `Wikipelago.yaml`)
2. Install into Archipelago (`custom_worlds` or double-click)
3. Restart Launcher → Generate → host
4. Play at https://wikipelago-contd.onrender.com/
v0.5.0-Bingo!.title: 0.5.0-Bingo!

v0.6.0-beta1.description:
## Play in your own tongue

- Seeds can use **English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, or Polish** Wikipedia
- **Client UI language** is separate from your seed’s wiki language, set it using the top right menu
- Bingo boards letter pairs frequency weights adjusted for every language. For now, special characters are still ignored to determine the starting letters of a page

## Practice mode

- Casual unlimited play without connecting to Archipelago
- Target pages are selected from the pool corresponding to the web client language setting

---

### Bingo

- New item: **Progressive Bingo Stamp** can stamp one cell on one of your bingo board. Use it for those rare ZQ cells!
- Bingo boards auto-hides on completition, and you can hide/show bingo boards whenever you like

### Misc. UX/UI

- Faster page loads (prefetch on hover) + loading indicator
- Side panel scrolls independently of the main playing area
- Small UI polish
- Balancing yaml defaults and range
- WSS for remote hosts (already on main), AP packaging/manifest fixes (already on main)

Requires Archipelago **0.6.7**. Web client: https://wikipelago-continued-dev.onrender.com/

---

**Host:** install this `Wikipelago.apworld` and generate a new seed for 0.6 features.  
**Players:** Use default yaml or make your own, then with web client only.
